faqIntro.title: Cau hoi truoc khi dung
faqIntro.text: Nhung diem quan trong khi bien bo skills nay thanh may ban hang affiliate thuc te.

faq.title: Affiliate Skills co phai SaaS khong?
faq.text: Khong. Day la bo skill dang Markdown va workflow de AI cua ban thuc thi. Ban so huu quy trinh va co the tuy bien.

faq.title: Co can biet code khong?
faq.text: Khong bat buoc. Nhieu skill tao output text hoac HTML tu chua. Neu muon deploy GitHub Pages hay Vercel, biet command co ban se co loi.

faq.title: Landing page tao ra co dung de chay ads khong?
faq.text: Co the dung lam diem den, nhung ban can kiem tra policy nen tang, disclosure, claim va tracking truoc khi chay ngan sach.

faq.title: Co thay the nghien cuu thi truong khong?
faq.text: Khong. No giup ban nghien cuu nhanh va co cau truc hon. Nhung offer, claim, gia va chinh sach affiliate van can duoc kiem tra truoc khi publish.

final.title: Lay Affiliate Skills va tao landing page dau tien trong hom nay
final.lead: Dung bo skill nay de tim offer dang gia, viet noi dung co ly do de click, va dua traffic ve mot trang ban hang gon, nhanh, do duoc.
